acceptance_predicates.description: asb workload install/list/status/select/repair/update/remove is separate from asb tool and operates on workload bundle records.
asb workload install supported-id downloads and prepares every AR-1781 catalog-pinned development workload by default, including SWE-mini.

Production authorization, release signing, or hosted verification absence cannot block development installation or selection; immutable identity and declared legal/resource constraints remain enforced.
Identity/proof/license/size/archive/preparation/adapter validation completes before atomic project-local publication and receipt registration.
Read-only operations are network-free; update/repair/rollback/offline/stale/revoked/incompatible paths preserve prior usable bundles and report distinct causes.

definition_of_done: Every cataloged external workload class has deterministic install/lifecycle fixtures and SWE-mini has explicit coverage.
Independent review and exact-head/exact-main evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1781 official external workload source catalog.

outputs.description: Dedicated verified project-local external workload lifecycle command.

gates.description: Identity, proof, license, archive, preparation, atomicity, and hostile-input gates pass.
